item.title: 7 Renter-Friendly Ways to Keep a Small Apartment Warm
item.description: Is your rental drafty or chilly when the weather turns? These 7 renter-friendly ideas help keep a small apartment warmer using curtains, rugs, draft stoppers and simple layout changes. Nothing needs drilling or permission from your landlord in most leases. Save this before the cold weather arrives.

item.title: 7 Budget Wall Decor Ideas for Small Apartments
item.description: Bare walls but a small budget? These 7 wall decor ideas add personality to a small apartment without clutter or big spending: large art, mirrors, plates, textiles and more. Renter-friendly options included.
